title: Hunts FH-020S: Staff scan route, nonce table, audited override and held-claim review

source.ref: Split from FH-020 (2026-11-10): the proof core shipped in lib/hunts/staff-proof.ts; the stateful and screen halves need a migration and screens.

detail:
Add the single-use nonce table (service role, unique insert backing consumeNonce), the staff scan route and screen, the audited override, the support appeal, and the held-claim review that resumes once after authorized review. Done when: cross-Space staff, replay, expired proof and a paused placement reject through the route, and an authorized review resumes a held claim exactly once. Requires: FH-020, FH-010, FH-019. Owner role: Game systems.

Built 2026-11-10: migration 20270346038000_hunt_staff_review.sql adds hunt_staff_nonces and three service-role functions: hunt_staff_nonce_consume (a unique insert spends a nonce once), hunt_claim_review (approve, reject or override a held claim; the claim and run locks make an approval resume exactly once, an override needs a written reason and is audited as claim_override) and hunt_claim_appeal (one open appeal per claim). lib/hunts/staff-review.ts verifyAtDoor runs decide('verify_claim'), the proof, the nonce spend and hunt_claim_apply at assurance staff; app/api/hunts/staff/verify/route.ts is the POST, dark behind HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED, signed with HUNTS_PROOF_SECRET. supabase/tests/hunt_staff_review.test.sql proves nonce, resume-once, key conflict, rejection, appeal and override on the sequential path; two live sessions racing is carried by the claim lock, the run lock and the nonce primary key. Staff of a venue Space means canEditProfile there. The screens that call the route are FH-020T. The migration is NOT applied in production until the owner runs it.

append.detail: Packet F UI slice: components/hunts/staff-proof-screens.tsx supplies Focus scan and Stream held-claim review shells. Claude owns route authorization, nonce storage, review actions and audit.
